best_echo_sets.commentary: Carlotta's best set bar none, that gives her an unconditional 12% Skill DMG Bonus, 22.5% Glacio DMG Bonus and up to an extra 36% Skill DMG Bonus when casting 2 or more Ultimates (a condition that she easily fulfills). Overall gives a total of 70.5% DMG Bonus at maximum which should speak volumes on how good this set is for Carlotta.

main_echo_options.echo_commentary: The best Main Echo choice for the Frosty Resolve set as it grants 12% Glacio DMG and 12% Skill DMG Bonus when equipped in the main slot. Its active skill also deals a chunk of damage while freezing enemies in place for a short amount of time if fully stacked (which only Carlotta can do). The base cast can also be used during optimized Opener rotations to squeeze a small amount of extra damage.

best_weapons.commentary_details: The best Carlotta stat-stick that gives her a simple 12% ATK and 48% Skill DMG via its passive as well as a huge CRIT DMG stat and a good Base ATK. Pretty self-explanatory.

sections.heading: Summary
paragraphs: Carlotta is a 5-star Glacio Pistol wielder who specializes in dealing incredible Resonance Skill-focused damage while playing from a distance. Similar to characters like Camellya or Jiyan, Carlotta is a Hyper Carry DPS with monstrous damage and high field time requirements. She operates best in teams that can stack buffs on her just before she executes her burst damage rotations.

What sets her apart from the rest of the crowd are her Element and Weapon Type. Carlotta is the first dedicated Limited Glacio DPS in the game and further, she's also the first 5-star Pistol user, breaking new ground in both categories. In addition, unlike most other characters, Carlotta gets to use her Resonance Liberation up to 6 times in a row instead of a measly 1, allowing for some tremendous flurries of burst damage when set up correctly. Lastly, most of the strongest DPS at the time of Carlotta's release are Melee-focused while she brings ranged capabilities to the table and does so without sacrificing any damage potential.

Carlotta is a character that is all about set-up and execution -she has multiple resources and features long cooldowns but has huge damage potential which makes lining everything up just right incredibly important to achieve. The name of the game when playing her is to accumulate her primary resource and Forte Gauge i.e. "Substance" and consume it to launch an empowered Heavy Attack whilst gaining a tremendous buff to Resonance Liberation focused abilities. After that, you unleash the big guns and fire off all 6 charges of her Resonance Liberation. The rest of your field time will be spent in setting up that with her abilities and the rest of your team. So without further ado, let's learn exactly how to do that.

First up, the most important thing is her Resonance Liberation which encompasses 3 separate abilities and a debuff. Upon activating the Liberation, Carlotta fires a large AoE Glacio blast at enemies and then activates "Twilight Tango" - a special state allowing her to access her other two Liberation abilities. While in "Twilight Tango" your next 5 Normal Attacks or Resonance Liberation casts are converted into alternative abilities. The first 4 are turned into "Death Knell" - a long-ranged Glacio Musket shot. Firing Death Knell accumulates 1 Meta Vector and upon gaining 4 Meta Vectors your next and last shot is enhanced into Fatal Finale (a huge AoE Glacio blast that concludes "Twilight Tango" and Carlotta's Ultimate). You'll be using all of these shots back to back and here is how it should look:

Each of these shots, despite being Resonance Liberation abilities, is actually considered as Resonance Skill damage making building amplification and increases to this damage type a must-have for Carlotta.

Also included in her Resonance Liberation is "Deconstruction" - a debuff originally only accessible via the initial blast of her Liberation: Era of New Wave, but is extended to many more abilities thanks to one of her Inherent Ability. "Deconstruction" causes all damage you deal to affected enemies to ignore 18% of their DEF. This debuff lasts for 4 seconds but with the Inherent Ability active, it should always be active. "Deconstruction" can be applied by the following abilities:

Her Forte Gauge, "Lethal Repertoire" allows her to accumulate up to 120 "Substance" - a resource that can be acquired via a number of her abilities. While holding the maximum amount of "Substance" (i.e. 120), Carlotta gains "Final Bow" and activates "Tinted Crystal" gaining access to an empowered Heavy Attack, "Forte: Heavy Attack: Imminent Oblivion" which deals Glacio damage (considered as Resonance Skill DMG), reduces the cooldown of her Resonance Skill and places "Tinted Crystal" on cooldown for 22 seconds.

First, let's begin with "Final Bow" which just like "Twilight Tango" is another state and is intended to be stacked together. "Final Bow", when active, grants all three of Carlotta's Resonance Liberation abilities an 80% increase to their damage multipliers which at max rank looks like this:

It goes without saying, but this increase is huge as it approaches almost double the base damage. Because of this, lining up gaining "Final Bow" alongside your Resonance Liberation is an absolute necessity. Unlike "Tinted Crystal", "Final Bow" has no cooldown but will be removed when she is swapped off the field or after "Twilight Tango" ends.

Imminent Oblivion is always worth using when available, as it is a powerful part of her strongest burst rotation, due to it reducing the cooldown for Resonance Skill, allowing her to finish the combo by setting up the next one, which we'll be covering soon.

However, to access all of this, we need "Substance" and a way to generate it. Carlotta has primarily two ways to accumulate "Substance". The first method is straight up via using abilities whereas the second is to consume "Moldable Crystals" - a resource that is generated and consumed in order to either generate "Substance" and or to enhance other parts of her kit. Carlotta can maintain up to 6 "Moldable Crystals" on the field at same time. Each of the following abilities listed, generates 3 "Moldable Crystals" when used:
Mid-Air Attack: Customary Greetings (Accessible Directly After Standard Mid-Air)
Carlotta can consume these "Moldable Crystals" and or generate "Substance" with the following abilities:
Skill: Chromatic Splendor (Consumes all "Moldable Crystals" granting 10 "Substance" each)
Basic Attack: Necessary Measures Part 1 (Consume 1 "Moldable Crystals" granting 10 "Substance")
Basic Attack: Necessary Measures Part 2 (Consume 1 "Moldable Crystals" granting 10 "Substance")
Basic Attack: Necessary Measures Part 3 (Consume 1 "Moldable Crystals" granting 10 "Substance")

That is indeed a lot to take in, but to summarize it: Generate "Moldable Crystals" with abilities and consume them with others in order to generate 120 "Substance" to unleash a full powered Resonance Liberation. Once the rotation is fully laid out both "Moldable Crystals" and "Substance" will make more sense but first, let's discuss the rest of her kit.

The final thing to note about Carlotta's Forte is that she cannot gain "Substance" while in her Resonance Liberation "Twilight Tango" state and upon entering "Twilight Tango" will remove all "Substance". As such, avoid activating Resonance Liberation before hitting 120 "Substance" in order to ensure access to "Final Bow". Furthermore, also make sure that you consume "Substance" before activation of "Forte: Heavy Attack: Imminent Oblivion" so as to not to waste it.

Carlotta's Basic Attacks as we've seen above are capable of generating and consuming "Moldable Crystals" in order to generate "Substance" but are in fact not commonly used in her main combo (with many of the more streamlined versions actually excluding them all together). That said it doesn't make her Basic Attacks useless. In the event you need damage outside of Carlotta's main burst combo with a long cooldown, these can fit that purpose. Also when using some weapons and or in some combat scenarios they can fit in the main combo allowing certain issues to be solved more neatly.
If you intend on using them though the main things to know outside of the standard affairs are:
She has two sets of Basic Attacks - one to generate "Moldable Crystals" and one that activates when they are active and consumes them.
She has two Mid-Air attacks - a standard plunge and a Follow-Up that can be executed immediately after.

She also has two Heavy Attacks - a standard one and one that can be activated at the cost of consuming 120 "Substance' if "Tinted Crystal "is on a cooldown. On using this ability, just like Imminent Oblivion, it will lower her Resonance Skill Cooldown by 6 seconds.

Unlike her Basic Attacks, Carlotta's Resonance Skill is used constantly and is your main source of consuming "Moldable Crystals" and generating "Substance". Her Resonance Skill comes in two parts - Art of Violence and Chromatic Splendor, which as we've already learned generate and consume "Substance" and "Moldable Crystals":
Skill: Art of Violence -  Generates 3 "Moldable Crystals"
Skill: Chromatic Splendor - Consume all "Moldable Crystals" gaining 10 "Substance" Each

Both of these skills are a package deal and share the same 14-second cooldown. After using the first skill, Art of Violence you'll have a short window to activate Chromatic Splendor before the Resonance Skill is placed on cooldown, additionally swapping-out Carlotta before using it will also place it on cooldown wasting the second part. With this knowledge, we have now the next part of our combo and the backbone of our "Substance" generation covered:
To push this further we need her Intro skill Wintertime Aria which not only grants 30 "Substance" straight up but also spawns 3 "Moldable Crystals". If we throw this in the mix we get:

This combo alone grants us 90 out of our required 120 "Substance" leaving us just 30 short. The final 30 is where the earlier set-up on Carlotta comes into play. There are two ways to gain the final 30 needed. The first is to leverage the 6-second cooldown reduction from her Forte-empowered Heavy attack and finish her combo with a double Resonance Skill use the second is to start the fight with a double Resonance Skill use then swap to your other teammates while it comes off cooldown instead. In reality, you'll be using both of these methods!

Bringing it all together here is how we'll combine all of Carlotta's abilities to form her main rotation. On your very first rotation while at 0 "Substance" and without her Intro start the fight with the following to generate 30 "Substance":

After this execute the following rotation to gain the final 90, unleash a fully powered Resonance Liberation barrage, and set back up with another 30 "Substance" for the next time your cooldowns are available:
Skill: Chromatic Splendor - (Consume 6 "Moldable Crystals" for 60 "Substance")(Enter "Final Bow")
Mid-Air Atk (To return to the ground to continue combo)
Forte: Heavy Attack: Imminent Oblivion (Consume 120 "Substance" to reduce Cooldown of Skill)

By combining the set-up and full combo you'll be able to establish enough "Substance" and keep it rolling throughout the fight whilst using only the most potent abilities available in Carlotta's arsenal. This combo also lines up perfectly with many Support characters' abilities allowing lots of buff effects to be stacked during its duration increasing its damage potential even further.

In conclusion, Carlotta is a set-up and destroy specialist with a huge amount of damage at her disposal. A tremendous amount of her damage is considered Resonance Skill damage making building Echoes, Weapons, and most importantly teams around her efficient and effective. At the time of her release, she's definitely the premiere Glacio and Ranged damage specialist, while also putting up a great fight for the very top of the DPS meta.

synergies.commentary: Carlotta's best buffers and second slot partners as she ideally works in hypercarry compositions. Zhezhi and Lynae are easily the best ones as Lynae has a ton of super strong generalist buffs while Zhezhi gives Carlotta a lot of Energy to lower her Energy Regen requirements while also giving the highest DMG Amplification of all her Supports (45% total) and having fast rotation times, enabling consistent 25s team loops. Brant and Cantarella are good alternatives as while they only provide 25% DMG Amplification, they both have solid personal damage and retain reasonable rotation times.

Free-to-play accessible secondary characters for Carlotta teams. While Yangyang does not give any major buffs to Carlotta, her super fast rotation and extra Energy funneling via Outro (reminiscent of Zhezhi) make Carlotta easy to build and rotate with, while she can rely on her third slot partner for extra buffs making the team viable. While Taoqi does have 38% Skill DMG Amplification on her Outro, it does come at the cost of a rather slow and clunky rotation, next to nonexistent personal damage and she does also increase Carlotta's Energy Regen requirements. Overall, Yangyang will be much easier to play but Taoqi can yield higher results if played at her best. Choose based on what category of player you fit in.

These are all of Carlotta's 3rd slot teammate options. Mornye has a special synergy with Lynae since Lynae can apply Tune Rupture/Strain for Mornye to respond to them and provide her full array of buffs, making her the best choice if Lynae is in use. Shorekeeper and Verina are the next best ones as they tend to be some of the best generalist Supports for all ATK and CRIT-scaling DPS due to their super high buffs for short rotation times. Buling still does present herself as a good F2P alternative because Buling trades team-wide ATK buffs for Skill DMG buffs to Carlotta and more personal damage for slightly higher rotation times, which makes her not too far behind Verina, equaling her when optimized at S6.
